why: Adding explicit rules to keep numbers and multi-character names contiguous pushed the model to stop splitting amounts/names (small positive gains across bins), but the paraphrase of C8 about avoiding extremely short fragments was interpreted in a way that moved cuts earlier and produced isolated single-character pieces (e.g. splitting 你 / 的), which explains the harmful tail moves even though overall bins improved slightly.
lesson: When strengthening safety for numbers and names, make the ‘avoid extremely short fragments’ instruction precise so it does not encourage moving cuts earlier and creating isolated one-character fragments.
blamed: C8 «- Evaluate discourse connectors and coordination: conjunctio» (paraphrase)
insert: avoid cutting inside numeric expressions
insert: keep multi-character named entities and transliterations contiguous
